Blue Beyond the Clouds
Almighty Hurricane

moves.name:
Sacred
Hurricane
moves.description:
Activation Condition: When the user’s Sp. Atk is raised.
Deactivation Condition: Cannot be deactivated.

Never misses. Leaves the target confused. The power of this move is not lowered even if there are multiple targets. If the user’s Pidgeot has Mega Evolved, also doubles this attack’s power. When the user’s team does not have a sync buff, also reduces the user’s sync move countdown by 3.

moves.name: Protect
moves.description: Applies the Damage Guard Next effect to the user.

moves.name: Air Slash
moves.description: Has a chance (30%) of making the target flinch.

moves.name:
I’ll Tell
You!
moves.description: Reduces the user’s sync move countdown by one. Increases the user’s Special Moves ↑ Next effect by 5 ranks. If the user’s Pidgeot has Mega Evolved, also restores 1 MP of its Almighty Air Slash.

moves.name:
Blue Beyond the Clouds
Almighty Hurricane
moves.description: Become Mega Pidgeot until the end of battle. Applies the Enduring effect to the user the first time its sync move is used each battle.
